profile.headline: Experienced in Program Management and Governance in Master Data Management, Data Governance. Currently on Reltio MDM.
profile.summary:
Certified PMP since 2003, with experience spanning Project Management, Program Management, Account Management and Consultancy in setting up PMO at client sites.

Overall experience of 20+ years in various areas like Consultancy, Marketing, Operations.  Expertise in mobilizing / setting up teams for quick results.

Specialties: Setting up and Streamlining Project / Program Management processes including Governance and budgeting.

Using EPM tools like Planview to align organizational goals in a multi project / multi client environment

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software as a Service (SaaS) · Data Analysis · Reltio Cloud MDM

positions.title: Sr. Manager - Projects
positions.description:
Application Service Manager, MDM at client location.

Managing support and maintenance of the client's Master Data Management applications covering 3 regions.

Maintaining response within SLA's and improvements in systems performance.  Responsible for moving the Support Maturity to the next level.

positions.title: Lead Consultant
positions.description:
As Lead Consultant:
Delivered project / Program for clients that required delivery of customized application covering multiple vendors / multi locational teams.  This covered  development lifecycles covering all phases of analysis, design, development, testing and implementation. Installing PPM systems and training end-users as required, reporting on status. 

Worked with the clients on  estimation, planning and execution of project with specific focus on requirement analysis and design. 
 
Set up PMO process including project plan integration, critical path analysis, earned value reporting, risk management, scope change management, issue management, communication planning, budget and cost. 

Also did client management, including scoping and delivery requirements. Introducing project governance by defining, getting buy-ins from stakeholders, training, monitoring and reporting project related metrics and staff performance. Managing multiple teams and ensuring smooth delivery of projects. 

Helped set up the Change Control Board and setting up the Change Management processes for the whole program.

company.name: Mahindra Satyam / Satyam Computer Services Ltd.

positions.title: Deputy Practice Head
positions.description:
As Deputy Practice Head:
Delivered large scale multiple projects to clients located globally
- Led multiple teams of software professionals 
- Reporting based on TBEM (Tata Business Excellence Model)

** TBEM is a 'customised-to-Tata' adaptation of the globally renowned Malcolm Baldrige model.

Resources planning and maintaining both Top and Bottom line targets

Setting up the guidelines / processes for the first PMO for the company.
